title: If I could wear it like a cape, I would.
text:
If I could wear it like a cape, I would.. So you know which of these I am referencing: I bought the Long Pile Brown with Black Tipped Blanket, or "Brown" from the buttons above.

This blanket is AMAZING. I mean ABSOLUTELY, UNEQUIVOCALLY AMAZING.

I bought this for our living room sofa to entice my partner and I to cuddle more and watch movies during the cold months coming. We are enchanted by how furry it is, and both the coloration and texture lends a bear pelt type vibe rather than being synthetic, such as it is.

Being that it is bear-like, that also means it won't be silky or supple in ways other synthetic furry blankets can be when mimicking smaller animals, but it IS soft. It truly is, and the velvety underside is super nice against the skin. I've not had shedding issues with it as others mentioned. However, this thing is massive and weighted. Five pounds doesn't seem like much until you are laying down and buried under a heavy mass of plushy faux fur.

It's finally begun to get cool enough to use it and we actually slept with it on the bed the last two nights. We have slept so peacefully in ways I cannot express (we both usually wake up throughout the night, but haven't with this thing on us). The weight does not smother, it's soothing. Comforting. We did not experience overheating, even with an additional blanket and our sheet sandwiching us in.

I highly recommend the blanket for anyone, for anywhere in your home.
